Why I Love Meta’s New AI Agent Muse. Sort Of.
summary: Google’s Gemini has replaced my usual search engine for both personal and professional research, and that’s about it.  While I’ve spent pretty much my entire life with a computer screen available, many of the offerings from prior AI agents didn’t appeal to me.  The value proposition of Meta’s Muse isn’t that it’s going to add a new skill or hobby to daily life; it’s simply going to improve and optimize things you’re already doing every day or don’t do because they feel too cumbersome.
